stats.note: Zero cause/effect (eitza or cause-type) edges exist in the dataset for reference 153. All 8 nodes in the dataset for this Torah are bechina nodes and are fully covered by the 2 existing packages. The Torah's causal structure (having אנפין נהירין enables קבלת פנים; having אנפין חשוכין blocks reception) is implicit in the source text but no eitza edges are encoded in the dataset. No enrichment is possible until eitza edges are added.
